text:
marta: heads up — audit-bot flagged unexpected kms:Decrypt from analytics-service against customer-prod CMK at 2026-04-09T14:22Z. that key should only be usable by data-ingest and export-runner, not analytics-service. :rotating_light:

audit-bot: automated alert — iam_event: kms:Decrypt | principal: svc/analytics-service@redwood.internal | key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01 | location: us-west-2 | count: 3

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-09T14:10 by @leah — PR #4523 merged: role-mapping-refactor (roles: analytics-reader, data-scoped-reader)

sanjay: can someone paste the role -> policy diff? think the refactor touched role inheritance.

leah: quick excerpt from the post-refactor policy (only showing relevant lines):
```json
"roleMappings": {
  "analytics-reader": ["read:datasets", "kms:Decrypt"],
  "data-scoped-reader": ["read:datasets"]
}
```
this is wrong — analytics-reader gained kms:Decrypt during a merge conflict resolution. original earlier had kms:Decrypt on data-ingest-only.

tom: confirmed in cloudtrail logs: same service account used for decrypts. looks like analytics-service assumed analytics-reader role via container serviceaccount -> iam binding we rolled out last week.

marta: mitigation plan: 1) emergency deny policy on CMK to explicitly deny analytics-service principal 2) revoke STS/token for analytics pods 3) rollback role-mapping PR if quick fix not safe 4) rotate affected DEKs for impacted customers (if any decrypts succeeded). who can apply the CMK deny now?

sanjay: on it. applying key policy patch now to add explicit deny for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/analytics-service-role. command: 
```bash
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01 --policy file://deny-analytics.json
```
where deny-analytics.json contains an explicit Deny for kms:Decrypt from that principal.

leah: also immediately revoking the pod tokens: 
```bash
kubectl get pods -l app=analytics-service -n prod -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl delete -n prod
```
that forces restart and prevents further requests while we fix bindings.

tom: creating a temporary guardrail in IAM: removing analytics-service-role -> analytics-reader binding. doing that now.

marta: good. tom/leah/sanjay please update thread when each step done. I'll open a customer-impact tracking ticket and notify CS for any affected customers.

leah: key policy patch applied, pods restarted (14:31Z). I see permissions denied now on new decrypt attempts in CloudTrail.

sanjay: removed role binding (14:34Z). deploy-rollback PR #4527 prepared that reverts the inheritance change — waiting approval, tagging @marta for go-ahead.

audit-bot: new log — kms:Decrypt denied for analytics-service principal at 2026-04-09T14:33Z (policy DENY).

marta: approve rollback, tom please merge and coordinate canary. also start a short-lived rotation for any DEKs accessed between 14:10-14:30Z. we need a list of customers whose CMKs/dek ops saw decrypt success — leah?

leah: pulling decrypt success query now, will paste results in the ticket. preliminary: 2 decrypt successes for internal-test-customer, none for production customers so far.

tom: merged rollback PR #4527 at 14:39Z and kicked a canary (2 pods). monitoring logs for failed decrypts and new errors.

marta: next actions (owners):
- leah: finish decrypt success audit, list customers + timestamps (owner: leah)
- sanjay: file infra change to add unit test for role inheritance rules + blocklist of principals that must never get kms:Decrypt (owner: sanjay)
- tom: add pre-merge CI check in service-account-role mapping job (owner: tom)
- security: post-incident review + action items (owner: marta)

leah: copied audit results to ticket INC-2026-214 — only internal-test-customer had 2 decrypts at 14:14 and 14:19. rotating their DEK and notifying them now.

sanjay: raising a follow-up to update KMS key policies across accounts to have explicit deny for any non-data-ingest principals — will draft template.

marta: thanks all. big takeaway: implicit role inheritance during refactor is dangerous. we need stricter linting + pre-merge checks on any permission changes. marking this resolved for now after rollback and key deny. will schedule a postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT. :white_check_mark:
